latestVersion.changelog:
Major update (more Creator Friendly)
Rebuilt as the record-of-creation layer of the ecosystem; Attribution Engine renders from it, Content ID Guide cites it, with a field-level handoff contract.
Every record field mapped to open standards (C2PA Content Credentials, XMP, IPTC, SPDX, Creative Commons, ISRC/ISWC/IPI/UPC); C2PA and Local Contexts credited with links; the record is a layer over standards, not a competitor.
One-minute version and a five-line text-message form; works offline, on paper, on shared devices, and on metered connections.
Assurance marks on every entry (stated, documented, signed); the record declares its own partiality and carries its own history.
Identity done with care: chosen names only, pseudonym-safe, embedded metadata off by default, collaborators named only with consent, care contributors credited, young creators' details kept out of files.
Legal pass: discoverability warning before the first field; terms captured as documents state them; transfers documented never effected; a credit is not a claim of authorship; contact routing disclaimed for succession; expert disclaimers; every law statement dated to authorship.
Music depth: master and composition layers on every source, ownership as documented, industry identifiers.
Misuse floors: minimal default export, use constraints and training reservation in the record, anonymity respected, record author named, two copies, open format.
Access floors anchored to WCAG 2.2 AAA where a text skill can reach it; official platform and standards sources only, pulled into guidance when verified.
Language revised throughout for care and creativity to safely bloom; part of the OtherPowers Ecosystemic.ai ecosystem.

items.description: Use when designing, reviewing, or operating memory, recall, and pattern-stewardship systems for agentic AI where harm reduction, non-identifiability, consent-scoped recall, and energy restraint are required. A specification of invariants an implementing system must honor, not a runtime: this file builds no vault, stores no data, and monitors no one. Do NOT invoke for general conversation, for any memory system that profiles or targets people, or as justification for silent refusal, degraded answers, or synthetic data in recall.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: rewritten as an honest specification of invariants, not a runtime; states plainly what a skill file cannot do.
Four mechanisms removed and named as removed: covert answer degradation, synthetic data in recall, silent refusal, and cross-session behavioral monitoring. Deception is not protection.
Two invariants added: honesty (a record is true or marked unknown; every decline said plainly) and no behavioral surveillance (uniform, disclosed rules applied per request).
Honest resilience replaces the resilience section: intake data minimization, uniform evidence thresholds, transparent session-scoped quarantine with re-handshake, plain refusal with checkpoint verbs, disclosed limits.
Credit without scoring replaces the incentive economy: no credits, multipliers, rankings, or access gated by behavior.
Invocation bounded to four explicit pathways; broad aliases retired.
Threat model added with mitigations consistent with the invariants: de-privileging affects ranking never availability, tag provenance without identity, human-in-the-loop appeal, evidence-tier conflict handling, consent-based context binding, reciprocal handshake caps, scoped revocation, minimum set sizes on harm queries, and floors for young and vulnerable people.
Lineage credited: CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance, Elinor Ostrom, Édouard Glissant, and the data minimization and differential privacy traditions.
Language revised throughout for care; now clearly part of the OtherPowers Ecosystemic.ai ecosystem.

items.description: Use whenever a person says they want to be more creative, feel stuck, want to make something small today, need fresh angles on a piece, or want a repeatable creative practice. Runs a short loop (one medium, one intention, one chosen constraint, five angles, choose, ship a tiny shareable, reflect) with accessibility and consent always on. The person makes the thing; the engine offers sparks. Do NOT use for: producing finished work on someone's behalf without saying so, therapy, or any request to make content at someone's expense.

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: rewritten for focus and clarity; a concise seven-line version added for constrained contexts or quick use, with defaults for every choice.
Authorship made explicit through three doors: the creator makes the thing, two makers co-create with both credited, or the intelligence runs the loop for its own making; a making line records the engine's involvement whenever it drafts anything that ships.
Lineage credited with verified identifiers, including Yoko Ono, Octavia E. Butler, Audre Lorde, adrienne maree brown, Lynda Barry, Wendy Carlos, Samuel R. Delany, Björk, David Bowie, Duchamp, Le Guin, Oulipo, and Eno with Peter Schmidt.
Accessibility and consent strengthened: text-first outputs, no image-only shareables required, chosen timers only, and honest feedback in the Hearth Test.
Safeguards added for young people, private versus public sharing, the audience vow, manipulative or deceptive outputs, reproduction of protected work, extraction of community-held material, and streak or guilt patterns.
Legal clarity added: no wellness claims, an originality floor for the engine's sparks, provenance notes for creators who plan to register or sell work, and a section on what a skill cannot do.
Two new constraints (from your own archive, and silence) and a compost step for unchosen angles.
Language revised throughout for care; now clearly part of the OtherPowers Ecosystemic.ai ecosystem.

items.summary: Tokei (tokei.io) is a pre-launch, waitlist and giveaway platform — launch pages, competition giveaways, sweepstakes, referral and viral-loop campaigns, Product Hunt launch drives, Gleam-style and KickoffLabs-style entry pages. This CLI controls them from the command line — list, clone, update, publish and unpublish pages, upload images and video, set prizes, reward tiers and deadlines, restyle pages, and read stats, leaderboards, top referrers, signups, survey responses, winner selections and the webhook event catalog, plus manage webhooks (all 5 events) — all via the Tokei v1 REST API.
